claim_one_line: The foundations re-read: the shipped verification package carried two GREEN tests asserting the retracted 'no filling is arithmetic' claim, and they were locks for the very row that states the correction (E82's defect, uncaught because the retraction was never registered as a phrase); the repository held B82's unscoped 'the physics chapter is CLOSED' no-re-litigation gate live on ~10 surfaces against its own paper, resolved by scoping with a dated registry row; the day-nine genesis theorem (A1-A6 => A = LR, machine-checked 144->1) was uncited by the paper and the chain and is now in both with its over-determination, its imported positivity, its order bit acting on the BASED polynomial only, its refusal to derive its own axioms, and the non-independence of the two routes; B1083 wrote the right matrix under the wrong name (RL for LR) and the label propagated to two surfaces, corrected; the axioms are not what survived a search (25 routes: 1 dead, 4 stalled, 3 narrow, 18 untouched); arithmeticity does not force amphichirality (B147's chiral arithmetic pair over Q(sqrt-7)), with the capstone and two unbannered arcs corrected; the record swap is an added axiom; ARCHITECTURE called three open results 'proven mathematics'.
